name: party_member
_comment: One party member end to end: 4-direction idle, walk and run, an attack and a cast, all driven by the skeleton (the pose tier) with a wind-up before the strikes (anticipation), held wind-up and impact frames (holds) and a smear on the attack (off for attack_w: on that take the whole body leans into the lunge, and the smear dragged the coat and boots into a checker behind him instead of the blade, a smear bug), the hit-flash and dissolve shaders, the battle pose set facing left (poses: battle; pose_text rewords five of them for a fencer and names the rapier, which klein dropped otherwise) and a menu portrait with five expressions and talking frames. clip_fix holds the three retakes its review needed (a sword fragment on the north attack; the west attack, whose first take held the rapier pointing back behind him for most of the strike, so the figure read as facing the wrong way; a lost hat on the kneeling pose). The battle set's cast pose ships as cast_pose_w beside the cast clip. The longest example (a rotation + 19 skeleton clips, about an hour on a 16 GB card). Authored: written with Claude (Opus 5.5, claude-opus-5-5).

characters.name: duelist
characters.prompt: a dashing young swordsman with a red long coat, a black tricorn hat with a feather and a slim rapier in his right hand

motions.attack: draws the rapier back over his shoulder, then slashes it forward and down in one fast strike, then returns to the guard stance
motions.cast: keeps the rapier low in his right hand, draws the free left hand in, then thrusts it forward casting a spell with a small glow of light at the palm, then lowers it

pose_text.ready: the character takes a fencing guard stance: feet apart, knees bent, the rapier held out in front pointing left, the free hand raised behind him, the body and head still in side profile facing left
pose_text.victory: the character raises the rapier high above his head in victory with a big grin, facing left
pose_text.hurt: the character flinches in pain: the upper body tilts back a little, head ducked, eyes squeezed shut, both arms pulled in close, the rapier still in his right hand, both feet still on the ground, side profile facing left
pose_text.defend: the character hunches forward behind his raised free forearm held up in front of his face like a shield, the rapier held low in his other hand, side profile facing left
pose_text.jump: the character leaps high into the air with both knees tucked up and both feet off the ground, the rapier in his right hand, side profile facing left
